identity.name: G-Shock 5000 Series GW-M5610U JDM
identity.one_liner: The Japan-only GW-5000U — the square 5000-series case in a stainless steel bezel and Tough Solar — at sub-$300, the cleanest G-Shock ever made.

provenance_events.description: Casio Japan releases the GW-5000U as a Japan-only square G-Shock with a stainless steel bezel, Tough Solar radio-controlled, 200m water resistance.

narrative.story: The GW-5000U is the modern interpretation of the 1983 DW-5000C — the original G-Shock. Stainless steel bezel, Tough Solar (no battery changes), radio-controlled from 6 stations worldwide. The dial is the classic 5000-series black-on-white.
narrative.collector_notes: The case is 42.8mm but wears smaller because of the squareness. The bezel is the same brushed steel as the GW-5000G (the $750 full-metal version), but on a resin case.
